response.text: Your goal is to move off Zapier to self-hosted n8n by rebuilding 6 workflows. First, I will audit and map the 6 existing Zaps including the form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, Stripe payment to email receipt, and the three small Gmail filters. Next, I will rebuild the form to Google Sheets and Sheets to Slack alerts workflows in self-hosted n8n, rebuild the Stripe payment to email receipt and the three small Gmail filters in n8n, and test all 6 rebuilt n8n workflows with your team. Finally, I will hand over a short documentation detailing the 6 n8n workflows. I did nearly this: built an n8n workflow for form webhooks, Google Sheets API, and Slack API, leading to lead entry dropping from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. Which specific form tool triggers the form-to-Google-Sheets workflow?
